concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-custom-payouts-scheduled-payouts]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms balance-account sweep scheduling guide for user-bank transfer-instrument destinations, conditions, routes and distinct configuration/execution webhooks; no bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Keep Platforms scheduled bank payouts separate from the legacy Payout API and from internal transfers; a schedule-created webhook is not a transfer or receipt outcome.
